rule.name: UnboundedCollectionField
rule.message: This field of a singleton bean only ever gains entries, so memory grows for the life of the process. Remove the entry when its request, session or run ends (in a finally block or the close or destroy method), keep a bounded cache (Caffeine or Guava with a maximum size or expiry), or use a WeakHashMap keyed by the object. An exception fits only for a registry filled at startup.
